ONE LANE. SO MANY LITTLE STORIES.

Where shall we go?

A fictional para, inspired by the living traditions of North Kolkata.

Walk freely with W A S D or arrow keys. Drag the scene to look around. Walk close to a person, then tap their name to say hello.

 স্বাগতম · WELCOME

Make yourself at home.

01Wander the laneDrag to look around. Use W A S D, arrow keys, or the touch arrows to walk. Explore places walks you to a spot. Talk and shop when you are nearby.

02Step insideJoin the short queue at the pandal. Follow the volunteer through the entrance, then explore the courtyard and arati.

03Meet the paraWalk up to a character and tap their name to hear a Bengali greeting. Choose Translate to read it in English.

04Stay a little longerHave a virtual cup of cha, visit the balloon seller, play the balloon game, or save a postcard.

An original, stylised neighbourhood; not a reconstruction of a named Puja. Separate male and female Bengali voices are included. All stall activities use pretend money.

 THE INSPIRATION

Rooted in Kolkata.

The courtyard, community gathering, idol ensemble, drumming and evening arati draw on these references. The architecture and characters are original.
